description: Multiplex network-based agent simulation of mask-wearing behavior with information diffusion, social influence, and policy effects. Calibrated on days 0-29, predicts days 30-39.

parameters.initial_seeding_rule: use day 0 wearing_mask from train_data if present; else Bernoulli(p = 0.2 * risk_perception_clipped)

behaviors.name: decide_mask_use
behaviors.description: Agent updates mask_status based on persistence, peers, info, risk, and policy/enforcement; constrained by mask availability.

parameters.group_multipliers: odds multipliers by age_group and occupation

behaviors.algorithm: If wearing_mask_{t-1}=1: stay masked with probability rho (possibly modulated by info and policy). Else: compute logit p = alpha0 + beta_risk*risk_perception_t + beta_info*received_info_{t-1} + sum_L beta_peer_L * neighbor_mask_share_{t-1,L} + beta_policy * policy_active_t * trust_in_authorities * propensity_to_comply + group_offsets. Convert p via logistic to adoption_prob. If inventory_masks>0 and Bernoulli(adoption_prob)=1 then mask_status_t=1 else 0. If inventory_masks==0, attempt purchase_masks before finalizing.

behaviors.name: share_information
behaviors.description: Information diffusion across network layers plus external media.
behaviors.algorithm: For each agent: compute neighbor_info_share_{t-1,L}. Compute logit p_info = theta0 + sum_L theta_L * neighbor_info_share_{t-1,L} + theta_msg * (messaging_intensity_t * credibility). With probability p_info (logistic), set received_info_t=1; else if received_info_{t-1}=1, apply decay: received_info_t remains 1 with prob (1 - delta_info). Additionally, with probability epsilon_info, set received_info_t=1.

behaviors.name: purchase_masks
behaviors.description: Acquire masks subject to stock and income constraints.
behaviors.algorithm: If adoption_prob_t is high or policy_active and inventory_masks==0: request q=1 mask. If retailer.stock_level>=q and random()<supply_reliability then complete purchase, decrement stock_level by q, increment inventory_masks. Else, purchase fails; record stockout.

behaviors.name: comply_with_policy
behaviors.description: Translate policy announcements and enforcement into higher adoption odds and lower noncompliance.
behaviors.algorithm: When policy_active_t=1: scale adoption odds by exp(beta_policy * trust_in_authorities * propensity_to_comply). For mandated locations, with probability enforcement_probability*enforcement_strength, set instantaneous compliance=1 for the period; noncompliance_rate cannot fall below noncompliance_noise.

behaviors.name: update_risk_perception
behaviors.description: Adjust perceived risk based on cases and information.
behaviors.algorithm: risk_perception_t = clip( (1 - w)*risk_perception_{t-1} + w * normalized_daily_cases_t + message_effect_strength * received_info_t + misinformation_effect_strength * misinformation_exposure_t, 0, 1 ) where w=risk_update_weight_from_cases and misinformation_exposure_t can come from channels with message_bias<0.

behaviors.name: host_interactions
behaviors.description: Generate effective contacts per layer/day used for influence and noncompliance metrics.
behaviors.algorithm: On active days for each layer, compute neighbor shares among currently interacting ties (all layer edges scaled by activation weight). Use these shares in decide_mask_use and share_information; compute noncompliance_rate where requirements apply.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Neighbor mask use by layer shifts adoption probability via logistic terms.
interactions.effect: Increases adoption propensity proportional to neighbor_mask_share_{t-1,L} with layer-specific betas.

interactions.name: policy_compliance
interactions.description: Authority signals and enforcement increase adoption odds and reduce noncompliance in mandated layers.
interactions.effect: Odds multiplier on adoption; stochastic enforcement per contact.

interactions.name: media_exposure
interactions.description: Information channels raise perceived risk and info state; misinformation can reduce it.

interactions.name: retail_purchase
interactions.description: Agents buy masks from retailers if stock and budget allow.

interactions.name: location_interaction
interactions.description: Layer-specific interactions determine exposure to peers and enforcement context.
interactions.effect: Generates effective contacts; used to compute neighbor shares and noncompliance.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: Case incidence and messaging impact perceived risk.
interactions.effect: Risk updates feed into adoption decisions.

steps: Validate agent_id keys and symmetrize adjacency per layer; remove self-loops; deduplicate neighbors
Set initial states at day 0 from train_data if available: wearing_mask_0, received_info_0; else seed via probability proportional to risk_perception
Assign trust_in_authorities and propensity_to_comply from normals, clipped to [0,1], mean/std as parameters
Initialize inventory_masks via Bernoulli(wearing_mask_0) with 1 unit if masked, else 0
Set mask_quality by sampling weighted by mask_efficacy_mean/std or based on income proxy
Calibrate coefficients using days 0-29 (see algorithms.calibration) and store in parameters.calibrated_coefficients
Set authority policy schedule: policy_active from day >= policy_start_day
Initialize retailer stock and info channels

algorithms.calibration: Two-stage logistic MLE with hierarchical pooling. Stage 1 (information): Fit received_info_t ~ logit(theta0 + Σ_L theta_L * neighbor_info_share_{t-1,L} + theta_msg * (messaging_intensity * credibility) + group fixed effects + agent mask state lag if needed). Stage 2 (adoption): Fit wearing_mask_t ~ logit(alpha0 + beta_risk*risk_perception_t + beta_info*received_info_{t-1} + Σ_L beta_peer_L * neighbor_mask_share_{t-1,L} + gamma*wearing_mask_{t-1} + beta_policy*policy_active_t * trust * comply + group dummies). Translate gamma into retention rho. Use rolling-origin or day 0-29 for fit. Store coefficients in parameters.calibrated_coefficients.
algorithms.simulation_step: For each day t: 1) Authority.set_policy(t) and broadcast_message; 2) Information diffusion: for all persons, compute neighbor_info_share per layer and update received_info_t using share_information; 3) Risk update for all persons using update_risk_perception; 4) Compute neighbor_mask_share_{t-1,L}; 5) For each person, attempt purchase_masks if needed; 6) Decide adoption with decide_mask_use using calibrated coefficients and constraints; 7) Retailer.restock; 8) Compute metrics: overall adoption, noncompliance by mandated layers, mask availability, group disparities, estimated transmission reduction.
algorithms.neighbor_shares: For each agent i and layer L, neighbor_mask_share_{t-1,L} = mean(mask_status_{t-1} of neighbors in L) if degree>0 else 0. Similarly for neighbor_info_share.
algorithms.policy_enforcement: If layer has requirement and agent is in that layer today, with probability enforcement_probability*enforcement_strength, override to masked during that contact; record noncompliance if unmasked without enforcement.
algorithms.retailer_restock: Daily add Poisson(restock_rate_per_day * supply_reliability) to stock_level; cap if desired.
algorithms.estimated_transmission_reduction: For each layer L, A_L = adoption share in layer at day t. Reduction_L = 1 - (1 - e_sc*A_L) * (1 - e_wp*A_L). Aggregate with weights proportional to baseline contact rates.
